using CUDA
CUDA.allowscalar(false)
module Ref
# wk(x, y, tol, n, z)
#
# Accumulation of a local scalar inside a while that runs in each thread (the shape validate_while_in_thread offloads since v0.5.18).
#
# x: input of length n
# y: output of length n
# tol: stopping threshold
# n: length
# z: length-2 output; z[1] receives the count, z[2] the sum of the halved values
function wk(x, y, tol, n, z)
    tot = 0.0
    sm = 0.0
    for i1 = 1:n
        r1 = x[i1]
        while r1 > tol
            r1 = 0.5 * r1
            tot = tot + 1.0
            sm = sm + r1
        end
        y[i1] = r1
    end
    z[1] = tot
    z[2] = sm
    return nothing
end

end
module MC
using CUDA, LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

@inline function __stade_wa_xor(m::UInt32, u::UInt64, k::Int32)
        lo = shfl_xor_sync(m, UInt32(u & 0x00000000ffffffff), k)
        hi = shfl_xor_sync(m, UInt32(u >> 32), k)
        return UInt64(hi) << 32 | UInt64(lo)
    end

@inline function __stade_wa_lane1(m::UInt32, u::UInt64)
        lo = shfl_sync(m, UInt32(u & 0x00000000ffffffff), Int32(1))
        hi = shfl_sync(m, UInt32(u >> 32), Int32(1))
        return UInt64(hi) << 32 | UInt64(lo)
    end

@inline function __stade_wa_add!(arr, idx::Integer, val::Float64)
        m = active_mask()
        if m == 0xffffffff
            i = Int64(idx)
            if vote_all_sync(m, i == reinterpret(Int64, __stade_wa_lane1(m, reinterpret(UInt64, i))))
                v = val
                v += reinterpret(Float64, __stade_wa_xor(m, reinterpret(UInt64, v), Int32(16)))
                v += reinterpret(Float64, __stade_wa_xor(m, reinterpret(UInt64, v), Int32(8)))
                v += reinterpret(Float64, __stade_wa_xor(m, reinterpret(UInt64, v), Int32(4)))
                v += reinterpret(Float64, __stade_wa_xor(m, reinterpret(UInt64, v), Int32(2)))
                v += reinterpret(Float64, __stade_wa_xor(m, reinterpret(UInt64, v), Int32(1)))
                if ((threadIdx()).x - 1) & 31 == 0
                    CUDA.@atomic arr[idx] += v
                end
                return nothing
            end
        end
        CUDA.@atomic arr[idx] += val
        return nothing
    end

@inline function __stade_wa_add!(arr, idx::Integer, val::Float32)
        m = active_mask()
        if m == 0xffffffff
            i = Int64(idx)
            if vote_all_sync(m, i == reinterpret(Int64, __stade_wa_lane1(m, reinterpret(UInt64, i))))
                v = val
                v += shfl_xor_sync(m, v, Int32(16))
                v += shfl_xor_sync(m, v, Int32(8))
                v += shfl_xor_sync(m, v, Int32(4))
                v += shfl_xor_sync(m, v, Int32(2))
                v += shfl_xor_sync(m, v, Int32(1))
                if ((threadIdx()).x - 1) & 31 == 0
                    CUDA.@atomic arr[idx] += v
                end
                return nothing
            end
        end
        CUDA.@atomic arr[idx] += val
        return nothing
    end

@inline function __stade_wa_add!(arr, idx, val)
        CUDA.@atomic arr[idx] += val
        return nothing
    end

function cuda_kernel_wk_1!(n, sm, tol, tot, x, y)
    @inbounds begin
            __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
            if __tid > div(n - 1, 1) + 1
                return nothing
            end
            i1 = 1 + (__tid - 1)
            r1 = x[i1]
            while r1 > tol
                r1 = 0.5r1
                __stade_wa_add!(tot, 1, 1.0)
                __stade_wa_add!(sm, 1, r1)
            end
            y[i1] = r1
            return nothing
        end
end

function wk_cuda(x, y, tol, n, z)
    sm = CuArray([0.0])
    tot = CuArray([0.0])
    nthread_per_block = 256
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            tot[1] = 0.0
        end
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            sm[1] = 0.0
        end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_wk_1!(n, sm, tol, tot, x, y)
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            z[1] = tot[1]
            z[2] = sm[1]
        end
    return nothing
end

end

function wk_jacc(x, y, tol, n, z)

        end

            sm[1] = 0.0

import JACC

using JSON3
res = Dict{String,Any}()
res["device"] = string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device()))
for n in (100, 1000, 5000)
    x = [100.0 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(0.7 * i + 0.1 * i * i)) for i in 1:n]
    y0 = zeros(n); z0 = zeros(2); Ref.wk(x, y0, 0.5, n, z0)
    for (nm, run) in (("cuda", () -> begin y = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n); z = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 2); MC.wk_cuda(CuArray(x), y, 0.5, n, z); (Array(y), Array(z)) end),
                      ("jacc", () -> begin y = JACC.array(zeros(n)); z = JACC.array(zeros(2)); MJ.wk_jacc(JACC.array(x), y, 0.5, n, z); (Array(y), Array(z)) end))
        d = Dict{String,Any}()
        try
            (y, z) = run(); CUDA.synchronize()
            d["y_max_abs_diff"] = maximum(abs.(y .- y0)); d["count_cpu"] = z0[1]; d["count_dev"] = z[1]
            d["sum_rel_err"] = abs(z[2] - z0[2]) / abs(z0[2])
            d["ok"] = d["y_max_abs_diff"] == 0 && z[1] == z0[1] && d["sum_rel_err"] < 1e-10
        catch e
            d["error"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 600); d["ok"] = false
        end
        res["$(nm)_$(n)"] = d
    end
end
println(JSON3.write(res))
